title: Anyone else? Marble museum
content: I was in the mall world last night. There were a lot of stores, but one caught my eye . It was a marble store. I went in and there were sensory bins of marbles and a table of people. I sat at the table, and the instructor was handing us out activity sheets to do. It was like a daycare. I didn’t know anyone’s name, but they all knew each other. Anyone else?
